name: A Bridge-Stone

rarity.note: True wrought survival; the binding still holds.

summary: Cut stones from Velkash's original woven bridges — raised at the Concord's height, failed in the Sundering, quarried for the city's rebuilding. A few stones kept their thread of binding: warm to the touch on one face, silent, and utterly unwilling to fall. A bridge-stone placed across a gap will hold a loaded cart where engineering says it cannot. Masons study them for lifetimes and learn only humility.
origin: ~150 CoW — Velkash on the Silk; the bridges were woven, not built
current_whereabouts: Three set as threshold-stones in Velkash (by ancient right); two in private collections; one missing since the Toll War.
properties: Warm on the bound face, cold beneath
Holds any load across any gap it can span — the binding does not care about physics
Will not bind to new mortar: it accepts no partner but its old bridge
keepers: Velkash's three are civic treasures; collectors' stones are Septuary-certified heirlooms; the Censer lists them 'contained' with visible reluctance.
value_or_danger: A fortune. As an engineering sample: worth a realm's bridges.
adventure_hooks: The Toll-War-missing stone is found serving as a Skeleton Courts' anchor-stone — it has been holding a pier in place for sixty years and removing it drowns the harbor.
Players must move a threshold bridge-stone to save a collapsing archive shelf; the stone agrees to be moved for the first time in history.
